business_model.claim: The company is an online broker of securities and futures trading services, run from Hong Kong through operating subsidiaries. Its customers are mainly high-volume institutional and individual traders.

business_model.basis: Stated in the cited 10-Q and 10-K MD&A.
business_model.claim: Revenue is charged per transaction: flat-rate commissions on each futures contract, plus trading-solution fees charged at a fixed rate per transaction with a minimum monthly fee. Commission expenses are what the company pays its broker partners when it routes client orders to exchanges.

Commission expenses represent the fees we paid to our broker partners, when we place a client order to an exchange market through these partners.
